title: package: publish kinetic-agent as an npx-installable CLI package
rationale: cli.mjs and core/init.mjs are already built (U-38, U-40). The only missing piece is a package.json with a bin entry and an .npmignore, so any developer can run `npx kinetic-agent init` to scaffold a new project — enabling external adoption without a global install.
implementationHints: Create autopilot/package.json with: name='kinetic-agent', version='0.1.0', type='module', bin={'kinetic-agent':'./cli.mjs'}, files=['cli.mjs','core/init.mjs','core/templates']. Do NOT include state/, run.log, devlog.log, .account/, or node_modules.
Create autopilot/.npmignore listing: state/, *.lock, run.log, devlog.log, install.log, .account/, node_modules/, tests/
Verify cli.mjs has '#!/usr/bin/env node' as first line (it already does — U-38).
Add a 'postinstall' or 'prepare' note in package.json pointing to the README for the manual npm publish step — do NOT auto-publish from the engine.
Do NOT modify cli.mjs, init.mjs, or any existing engine file. This is packaging only.
acceptanceCriteria: autopilot/package.json exists with correct bin entry pointing to cli.mjs
autopilot/.npmignore exists and excludes state/, *.lock, run.log, devlog.log, .account/
package.json is valid JSON and passes `node -e "require('./autopilot/package.json')"`
